# relativeLuminance

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

WCAG 2.2 relative luminance of an sRGB colour, in `[0, 1]`. Black is 0, white is 1.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
relativeLuminance([r, g, b]: [number, number, number]): number
```
